scope: Durable presentation pin provenance: protected manual/suggested group ancestry, focused descendant capture, origin-scoped references, paged dormant pins, version-six persistence, normalized group catalogs, and cache-order preserving membership refresh.
previous_goal_turn_classification: progress: the native production model was visibly confirmed; this continuation implements and verifies the previously unfinished presentation-pin behavior.
runtime_dependencies: Unchanged Rust 1.96.0 / Bevy 0.18.1. Isolated Bevy 0.19.1 candidate remains unadopted; its patch predates this feature.

checks.command: cargo build -p visualyze --bin visualyze --example production_smoke --example composed_pin_smoke --offline --locked

review.method: Independent read-only review plus root review of changed source, runtime tests, native assertions and rendered artifacts; repository remains untracked, so comparison uses prior recorded source hashes.
fixed_findings: Capture enclosing visual groups even when the focused projection ends at a supplied descendant.
Use the projector-normalized group catalog, not raw retained suggestions after correction, dismissal or topology changes.
Refresh offscreen group membership without promoting those groups in the recency cache.
Bind each reference pin to its originating region, not a matching display ID elsewhere.
review.source_comparison: Main-tree source hashes from bevy-0.19.1-compatibility-2026-10-02.json, supplemented by blocked-route-recovery-validation-2026-10-02.json for public/toolchain files.

remaining_limits: Protected group membership/ownership changes report conflicts rather than automatic topology repair.
References remain origin-scoped; deleting the last relation can leave a dormant presentation pin if origin and target still exist.
Legacy display pins cannot inherit without provenance captured in their source context.
64 typed contexts, 64 protected groups, 128 group members, 65 supplied-path IDs, 130 display-path IDs and the shared 8 MiB persistence budget remain bounded.
Native actions use scripted viewer input; they do not establish physical-input latency, GPU presentation percentiles or human comprehension.
Quality calibration, held-out comparisons, routing-space enlargement, broader scale/performance and comprehension gates remain incomplete.

persistence.scope: Synchronous main-thread state preparation and atomic save, including existing-state validation, serialization, file/directory fsync. Acceptance and frame intervals include this cost when enabled. The fresh temp directory is retained for inspection; no user state is read or written.

production_native.interpretation: 38 actions and 33 saves passed with exact cached positions. Repository collapse 122.95 ms still misses 100 ms. The longest renderer handoff was 93.82 ms in this screenshot-enabled warm-file-cache run; absence of the historical one-second pause does not establish a fix. Expanded production view remains visually dense with overlapping routes/labels and Details obscuring the lower view.

pin_native.scope: Actual native composed display and isolated v6 persistence. Exact rendered pinned position checked across collapse/reopen/unpin/undo and parent return; exact canonical point and truncated anchors checked through database/table descent. Child-origin pins preserve their original anchors when displayed in parents, including collapse/reopen, open-origin navigation and undo. Inheritance never copies owned registry entries. Restart and eviction have separate worker/core regressions; this process does not simulate hardware input or establish latency percentiles.

rejected_native_attempt.failure: cached navigation moved geometry at repeat-package
rejected_native_attempt.resolution: Catalog-wide retention refreshed every group as recently visited, evicting groups from the prior package view. Refresh now updates membership in place; only displayed groups change recency. New order regression plus the identical native walkthrough pass. The failed run is not counted as a pass.
